name: itch-io-downloader
author: hanphone
title: itch.io Downloader
description: Resolve public/free itch.io game pages into a complete Gopeed file list (APK, Windows, macOS, Linux), refresh the short-lived signed URL, and resume dropped downloads on Gopeed 2.x.

settings.name: platform
settings.title: Download platform
settings.description: all: list every upload (default). apk: Android APK only (falls back to other files when no APK exists). desktop: Windows/macOS/Linux files.

settings.name: preferredPlatform
settings.title: Preferred file order
settings.description: Sorts the list so the most likely file for your device appears first. Gopeed's resolve dialog still preselects every file; uncheck the ones you do not want. auto = APK first, then desktop.

settings.name: externalHints
settings.title: List external uploads as text hints
settings.description: Pages can list files that are hosted elsewhere (MediaFire, MEGA, ...); itch.io only links to a landing page. When enabled, each such upload appears in the resolve dialog as a small .txt file with the link, so you can see what the page has and open it manually. Requires Gopeed 2.x.

settings.name: includeArm32
settings.title: Include arm32-compat APK
settings.description: Only affects platform=apk. When enabled, arm32-compat APKs are listed together with the standard APK. platform=all always lists arm32 APKs.

settings.name: cookie
settings.title: itch.io Cookie (optional)
settings.description: Only needed for pages that require an existing login or an age-confirmed session. Paste the Cookie header value from a browser request to itch.io. Stored in Gopeed's extension settings; never logged by this extension.

settings.name: fingerprint
settings.title: TLS fingerprint
settings.description: Browser fingerprint used by Gopeed for itch.io requests. chrome is recommended; none uses Gopeed's default HTTP client.
